_comment: Tile copy for each case study, keyed by slug. Editable in the browser under `npm run dev` — see tools/copy-editor.mjs. One file rather than per-study, because the same tile renders in two places: the index, and the next-study link at the foot of the other study. Edit it in either and both change. src/data/studies.ts keeps the structure — slug, cover image, archived — and reads these strings from here.

machine-readable-components.title: A component library a machine could read
machine-readable-components.summary: A machine proposed a rebuild of every component, and I overruled it where it was wrong.
machine-readable-components.coverAlt: An abstract still life in violet and off-white: frosted glass panels showing a component grid, a list, a card and a block of code, wired together by glowing cables into a central lit tile.

making-the-app-testable.title: The app that could not be tested
making-the-app-testable.summary: On iOS, 2.5 extra bookings for every 100, and an estimated $3.6 million a year.
making-the-app-testable.coverAlt: Two phone screens of the same Hotels.com stay. One shows a single photo of the room. The other shows several photos, the price, and a Book now button.

scaling-a-system.title: One design system for 100+ brands
scaling-a-system.summary: Each brand kept its look through tokens, and the components were built once.
scaling-a-system.coverAlt: An abstract still life in red and off-white: four frosted glass panels on plinths at the left, each showing a different layout, wired by glowing cables into one lit tile of stacked cubes at the centre, which feeds five labelled cards at the right, each carrying a tick.
